name: risky-business
description: Risk - online multiplayer world domination with an MCP server so AI agents can play too

scripts.build: npm run build -w @risk/engine && npm run build -w @risk/mcp && npm run build -w @risk/client && npm run build -w @risk/server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @risk/engine && npm run build -w @risk/mcp && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @risk/server" "npm run dev -w @risk/client"
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @risk/engine && npm run build -w @risk/mcp
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test -w @risk/engine && npm run test -w @risk/server
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @risk/engine && npm run test -w @risk/server
